dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rg2s](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rg2s) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 76.347 depth occurred on Oct 10 2025 43 km SE of Severo-Kuril’sk, Russia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 50.3802 longitude 156.5204. It impacted 939 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
